title: Knowledge check: Ranking and Frequency Analysis
status_note: Protected question bank. Answer keys and explanations belong to the repository-side assessment source; the course API should expose only question prompts when a reviewed assessment endpoint is implemented.

questions.prompt: Which learning objective is most directly associated with “Ranking and Frequency Analysis”?
options: Apply ranking and frequency analysis to the relevant part of a structured-data workflow and verify the result.
Ignore the output labels and assume the input schema is always correct.
Replace validation with a manual visual guess and keep no record of assumptions.
Choose an operation without checking its effect on data types or missing values.
questions.answer_key: Apply ranking and frequency analysis to the relevant part of a structured-data workflow and verify the result.
questions.explanation: The lesson is scoped to ranking and frequency analysis. The correct approach is to apply the relevant concept to structured data and verify the output rather than relying on assumptions.

questions.prompt: What is the most reliable way to check work involving ranking and frequency analysis?
options: Inspect relevant labels, dtypes, missing values, row counts, and expected results.
Assume the operation cannot change the result shape.
Drop all rows or columns before checking whether they contain useful information.
Ignore version notes even when code depends on a version-specific default.
questions.answer_key: Inspect relevant labels, dtypes, missing values, row counts, and expected results.
questions.explanation: Validation makes the expected data shape and behavior explicit. Check the fields and edge cases that affect this operation before treating the result as trustworthy.
